spans.text: ...The Griffin T-Dolls cheer in victory within the Griffin temporary command post.
...A-alright! Thank you for your hard work, everyone!
Please stay at your posts, process your casualties, and wait for new instructions from the Commander!
Commander! We've confirmed that the Sangvis forces pursuing us have been completely wiped out!
I don't know who's helping us, but we're safe for the time being!
Also, here's a list of the T-Dolls who couldn't catch up...
Some were left behind from retreating units, others were separated from their commanders or belonged to support units...
Everyone's counting on you to lead us out of here, but they're also hoping that you can rescue their comrades if you can spare the effort.
That said, luck might still be on your side since the Sangvis pursuit has been halted, Commander!
...Psst...pssst...
All personnel in Area S11... attention... all personnel... appeared within the area...
...Psst...psst...
No good, comms are still being heavily disrupted.
We won't be able to contact Miss Helian like this...
...Yeah, the messenger Doll has already set out with your orders.
She's a cocky newcomer, but she'll definitely take the mission seriously!
I just hope...she'll come back safely...
How...did the operation turn out like this...?
Commander...
The AR Team and the other T-Dolls...Even the other commanders...Don't tell me we were the only ones who made it out of there...
Yeah...I'm sure that isn't the case! I know that was just my imagination running wild!
...Understood, Commander! I'll keep an eye out for survivors during our withdrawal!
Saving as many T-Dolls as possible is the only thing we can do now!
